title: Huk ratullapi puriq Trono
intro: Ancha atiyniyoq runan kamachirqan qhapaq suyuta, mana tupuy atiy qhapaq kaywan saminchasqa. Mana suyasqanchik sasachakuy hatariptinqa, kay kamachikuqqa manam espadakunawanchu pruebapi tarikurqa, aswanqa yachaywan iñiywan ima. Imachus sut’inchakusqanqa kay pachaq atiypa hatun kayninmanta sonqoq ukhunmanmi t’ikrakunman.
clues: Mana yuyaykuy atina qhapaq kaywan, allin kawsaywan ima saminchasqa reinotan kamachirqani
Atiyniyoq reymi karqani, chaymi mana manchakuq cartata chaskiwaranku, chaypim mañakurqaku kasukuyta
Nobleykunaqa yuyaychawarqankun kay karu reywan maqanakunaypaq icha thak-kaypichu kanaypaq
Hatun regalokunawanmi rirqani kikiy kay karu reywan tupanaypaq
Reypa tiyanantaqa huk ñawi ch’ipiyllapin karu hallp’aman aparqanku, manaraq kutimushaqtiy
Vidrio hina llañu pampayuq palacioman yaykuspaymi, Allahman kasukusqayta willakurqani

arabic: فَلَمَّا جَآءَتْ قِيلَ أَهَـٰكَذَا عَرْشُكِ ۖ قَالَتْ كَأَنَّهُۥ هُوَ ۚ وَأُوتِينَا ٱلْعِلْمَ مِن قَبْلِهَا وَكُنَّا مُسْلِمِينَ
verse: So when she arrived, it was said [to her], "Is your throne like this?" She said, "[It is] as though it was it." [Solomon said], "And we were given knowledge before her, and we have been Muslims [in submission to Allāh]. (27:42)
